report.summary: Closure audit of frozen range f83f703c→750cf0bc for Build A "Numbers you can trust", using only the frozen request.json. The range contains exactly one source correction (9562c373 in tradingagents/dataflows/vendors/sec_documents.py plus a regression in tests/test_sec_documents.py) and documentation/receipt updates. The correction addresses the single finding the implementer upgraded to material from the initial independent Claude Fable audit (run e43af411, 0 Critical/High/Medium, 9 Low): generic expect/guidance boilerplate previously shared priority tier 3 with statement/obligation tables and could displace them under the bounded extraction budget. I verified analytically from the frozen code that the new regression test fails at base (boilerplate keys (3,6,…) beat the statement table's (3,2,…) under a 19,320-char budget) and passes at HEAD (tables tier 3 vs boilerplate tier 1), that the tier-4 prioritize_guidance path protecting the latest 2.02 exhibit is untouched, and that the pre-existing late-guidance and late-financial-notes tests still select correctly under the new sort key. The acceptance addendum is internally consistent (3134→3135 passed with exactly one added test; exact commits 9562c373/750cf0bc identified; unpushed candidate, pending closure review, and CI/install gaps disclosed). The findings-review document disposes all nine initial Low observations with requirement-grounded rationale; the archived initial-audit JSON matches the summarized ledger and results; the runtime receipt delta is temp-path-only with unchanged source_state_sha256, consistent with a display-priority fix. No in-scope Critical, High, or Medium findings. Remaining observations are Low: non-latest-document guidance now ranks below financing-scope prose without a dedicated competing-tier test; the new bool(numerical_guidance) secondary sort key precedes hits in every tier (minor untested reordering within tiers 2–3); and the previously deferred misleading "package remaining 4000 characters" gap wording persists as documented. Passing this closure audit grants no integration or release authority; exact-candidate remote CI and install verification remain open as the acceptance report states.
limitations: Read-only static audit of the single frozen request.json (base f83f703c -> head 750cf0bc); no tests, linters, or application code were executed by this auditor. Baseline-fail/head-pass behavior of the new regression was established by manual trace of the frozen code, not by running pytest.

Builder receipts (pytest 3135 passed/10 skipped/1 deselected, 67 focused passes, ruff clean, /tmp proof logs, sanitized runtime receipt) are accepted as builder evidence, not independently reproduced; private replay inputs (saved DOCN state, publication store, SEC cache) were not available.

HEAD context was limited to the modules supplied in the frozen requirements blob; unlisted callers and the full crowded-package fixture bodies were assessed only through supplied excerpts and the diff.
Exact-candidate remote CI and fresh-install verification remain open because the candidate is unpushed; this audit cannot close that gap.
The initial audit's nine Low dispositions were reviewed for documented reasoning and consistency with the frozen plan, not re-derived from scratch against every owning module.
No evidence outside the frozen file was used; the repository working tree, git objects, and network were not consulted.

findings.title: Numerical-guidance blocks in non-latest documents now rank at tier 1, below tier-2 financing-scope prose; a real guidance sentence in a 10-K/10-Q competing with financing prose inside one bounded document is not covered by a dedicated test (bounded: the latest 2.02 exhibit keeps tier 4 via prioritize_guidance, and guidance still outranks same-tier generic prose via the new secondary key)

The new secondary sort key bool(numerical_guidance) precedes the hits count in every tier, so within tiers 2-3 an expect-bearing block outranks blocks with more financial hits; this cross-tier reordering side effect of the fix is untested and could marginally change which same-tier blocks survive the budget

Previously deferred Low persists at HEAD: the latest-8-K-primary truncation gap text still says 'package remaining 4000 characters' when 4000 is the special per-primary allocation, not the package remainder; documented as a deferred cosmetic diagnostic in the findings review, and the omission itself is still reported

The findings-review narrative describes the reproduction as '60 numbered expectation boilerplate paragraphs'; the committed regression uses 60 identical unnumbered paragraphs containing the year 2026 (digit-bearing, not numbered) - a cosmetic description/test mismatch with no effect on the proof's validity

Closure chain remains open by design: the acceptance addendum correctly states the independent review of the final correction was pending at head and the candidate is locally unpushed, so exact-candidate remote CI and clean-install verification are unverified; this run satisfies the pending closure review but grants no integration or release authority
